newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi's external trade in June valued at 1.3 billion dirhams.
- Dubai ports see 27.2 billion dirhams in trade in the first three months of this year.
- Turkey occupies Iraqi territory with America's blessings.
- UAE banks post good performance in the first half of 1996.
- Traffic accidents take heavy toll in UAE. Study says they constitute second major cause of death.
- Non-oil trade in Dubai surges 17 percent in first four months of this year.
- Gulf states oppose Turkish plan for security zone in northern Iraq.
